en.text:
Only usable while airborne.

Performs a dive to the ground in the direction of your movement input. Not inputting a movement direction results in a vertical downward dive.

Applies <solar/>Cure x2 to you and allies within 9 meters upon landing.

var solar3 = • Deals 100 Damage and applies 40 <solar/>Scorch Stacks (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) to enemies within 5 meters upon landing.
